title: Agent can process vendor credit notes

en.title: Agent can process vendor credit notes
en.summary: Payables Agent can recognize a vendor credit note and produce a purchase credit memo and applies to the original invoice, using the same draft and task experience as invoices. Note: It does not have Return Order matching functionality.
